questions.question: The new policy will come into _____ next month.
questions.explanation: come into effect 是固定搭配，意为'生效'。affect 是动词，effort 意为'努力'，efficient 是形容词。

questions.passage: Environmental protection has become a global concern. Governments around the world are taking measures to reduce pollution. For example, many countries have banned single-use plastics and are promoting renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power. Individuals can also contribute by recycling, using public transportation, and reducing energy consumption at home.
questions.question: What is one measure mentioned in the passage to protect the environment?
questions.explanation: 文章明确提到 many countries have banned single-use plastics。A、C、D 均与文意相反。

questions.question:
将下列句子翻译成英文：
读书不仅能增长知识，还能开阔视野。
questions.explanation: 翻译要点：'不仅...还...' 用 not only...but also...；'增长知识' 用 increase/gain knowledge；'开阔视野' 用 broaden horizons。
questions.reference: Reading can not only increase our knowledge but also broaden our horizons.
